author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Looking for a freelance graphic designer
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for: social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone who has a good eye for clean and modern design, can follow brand guidelines / references well, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Follow-up: This will be freelance / project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects if we work well together. If interested, drop your portfolio + rate in the comments or DM me.
